footer.tagline: A free progress tracker for Game Name. Your data stays in your browser, or in your own cloud storage if you turn on sync.
footer.disclaimer: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the publisher or developers of Game Name.
footer.framework: Built with the Gamerdex framework, a shared base for free game progress trackers.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Your playthroughs are safe and nothing was changed.
notFound.noPlaythrough: No playthrough is selected, so Overview has nothing to show. Pick one on the Playthroughs page.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The app hit an error. Your saved data has not been changed.
error.confirmBody: This removes everything the app stored in this browser. A copy of the raw data is downloaded first so it can be repaired later. Playthroughs synced to a cloud account stay there.
error.noData: There is no saved data in this browser.
